source: OpenAlex API /works (IDs written from the response by scripts/run_search.py)
query: WhatsApp AND (neighbourhood OR neighborhood OR "residents" OR "housing society" OR community)
filter: title_and_abstract.search.exact:WhatsApp AND (neighbourhood OR neighborhood OR "residents" OR "housing society" OR community),is_retracted:false,publication_year:2022-2026
oql:
get works where retracted is (false)
  and year >= (2022)
  and year <= (2026)
  and title-abstract has ("WhatsApp" AND ("housing society" OR "community" OR "neighborhood" OR "neighbourhood" OR "residents"))
